problem: reuses forward-generated products on the return receiver
action_taken: forward generation is collected only at the forward terminal; passes 1 and 3 receive it, pass 2 receives none

numerical_consequence: local/remote incident ratio = 1/exp(-aL); the return pass leakage is larger than the legacy value
